name.description: What this list is called in Studio.

origin.description: Where the list came from: "custom", or "copy:<built-in key>". Absent means custom.

value.description: What is stored in the column, e.g. "DE".

label.description: What the form shows. Absent shows the value.

tone.description: A colour name for the badge that shows this value.

description.description: The detail line of a choice card.

description: One option list. The file name is the list key that rules name.
